task: Show a five-stage loading workflow throughout audit submission and polling, then automatically display the returned report.
nonGoals: Backend progress instrumentation, scoring or extraction changes, new AI calls, deployment or merge, password or usage policy changes.

outcomes.description: Page download, Data extraction, AI Review, Score Card Building and Audit complete appear in a visible accessible loading block from submission until terminal response. No invented per-stage timing.
outcomes.evidence: Progress component fixtures and render tests; browser interaction evidence for deferred submission/polling.

outcomes.description: Complete and partial reports open automatically only after processing ends; cancellation, errors, timeout, auth expiry and cached responses remain honest and retryable.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen progress state cases, component tests and browser mocked API transitions.

outcomes.description: Password gating and usage safeguards remain intact with no backend changes or new audit calls during testing.
outcomes.evidence: Existing preview and backend regression checks; isolated browser mock responses.

process.description: Commit valid plan before edits, evaluate real named commands, independently review and open PR for hosted CI.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluator record and CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing visual styling, keep mobile layout and reduced-motion accessibility, and avoid extra requests or fabricated stage completion.

exitTest.reason: Application loading UI only; no change to agent workflow, memory, portability or resumability. Existing exit smoke tests still run.
